newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Xerox target price upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Xerox target price upped.

text.p: Prudential Securities analyst Alex Henderson said he raised his 12-month price target on Xerox Corp to $95 per share from $85.
-- Analyst said the higher target is based on a conversation with Xerox Chief Executive Paul Allaire.

-- Henderson said company has indicated the digital product line introduced in April "is way ahead of plan, so far ahead of plan, the company is more than doubling production targets for the second half" of the year.
-- Xerox shares were up 1/2 to 77 in early New York Stock Exchange trade.
